component.name: GameSwap
component.summary: Swap installed Steam games between libraries

description.p: Choose a game from each Steam library and swap their locations with a native, responsive interface.
GameSwap copies and verifies game files and related Steam data before removing originals. Interrupted operations keep a recovery checkpoint.

ul.li: Search installed games by name or Steam AppID
Resume interrupted swaps without discarding verified copies

description.p: Native libadwaita interface and Linux package build support.
